cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Request an Exception
cards.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me submit the form tomorrow. Today can be a trial extension.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll leave you the draft today. We can test one extra day on the final copy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mark it as the one-day trial. I'll attach the result to my next extension request.

reason: A3 gives B usable interim work; A5 uses the one-day limit as the documented trial for a future request.
